description.description: Detailed implementation instructions for the worker agent

directory.description: Relative path from project root to the agent's working directory (e.g., 'src/services/auth-service'). Empty or omitted means project root.

files.description: Relevant file paths relative to the task's directory

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task was completed

notes.description: Agent observations, warnings, suggestions for next iteration

dependencies.description: Task IDs that must be complete before this task

model.description: Which Claude model to use. Use 'sonnet' for straightforward tasks (add validation, write tests, simple CRUD). Use 'opus' for complex tasks (architectural decisions, subtle debugging, multi-file refactors).

agent.description: Name of a .claude/agents/*.md specialist agent for this task (omit for default generalist)
